shortDescription: Sri Lankan shares closed lower on Tuesday, dragged by energy and industrial stocks.* The CSE All-Share index CSELK:ASI settled 0.38% lower at 19,983.78 points* Serendib Land PLC CSELK:SLND.N0000 and LAUGFS Gas PLC CSELK:LGL.N0000 were the top percentage losers, down 12.5% and 10.4%, respectively…
